method: spherical-harmonic truncation of both models at T120 before scoring

truths.raob: radiosondes (explorer mirror): z500 and 850 hPa T, log-p interpolated
truths.era5: ERA5 (ARCO) 1.5° block means of the truncated fields, NH 20-80N
truths.era5-block: legacy: 1.5° block means of the raw 0.25° fields

acc_base.raob: each station's own IGRA day-of-year median (skewt-climo)
acc_base.era5: ERA5 1991-2020 ±7d day-of-year climatology (WB2), NH; t850 from 00/12Z

models.matched: AIFS-ENS member 0, spectrally matched to the single
models.ensmean: AIFS-ENS mean, control + 25 members (not a single model run)

matching.gain: f(l) = min(1, sqrt(P_single(l) / P_member0(l))), mean spectra of the previous 40 runs at the same lead, 5-degree running mean of the ratio, f(0) = 1

diff_test.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over runs, 4-run (2-day) blocks, 2000 resamples, 95 % percentile interval; significant = interval excludes 0
